name: shadPS4
requirement: Experimental PS4 emulator. You supply a prepared game folder or eboot.bin, plus any firmware the title needs. Tools opens Big Picture mode. Library Play uses -g on that path with isolated XDG folders. Package extraction and a PS4 system descriptor remain separate.
